messages:
support-bot: ticket C-7921 from CustX — they see p99 latency ~2.3s for /v1/generate from eu-west since ~09:15 UTC. Customer attached request ids and a few tcp traces. Noted TLS handshake time increase and some cross-AZ hops.

alex: looking at metrics — p95 up from ~380ms to ~1.4s and p99 jumped to ~2.3s across eu-west region starting 09:14. Spike aligns with increased TLS handshake durations. Collecting service traces.

maria: pulled in egress/ingress traces for eu-west-pop-a and pop-b. I see a bifurcation — ~85% of traffic fine, ~15% flows to a different POP with higher egress latency. No infra deploys in that window.

jin: double-checking GSLB and DNS returns — running dig from probe hosts now.

jin: ```
; dig +short _service.redwood.example A @8.8.8.8
193.0.2.10  <-- eu-pop-a
198.51.100.22 <-- eu-pop-b (higher RTT)
```

maria: traceroute from customer-probe to 198.51.100.22 shows extra cross-AZ hop: ```
traceroute to 198.51.100.22
 1  10.0.0.1
 2  198.51.100.1
 3  203.0.113.5  (other-az-pbr)  60 ms
 4  198.51.100.22  320 ms  <-- long TLS handshake prep
```

ops-bot: route-prober results: eu-west-pop-b p99 TCP handshake 310ms, eu-west-pop-a p99 48ms. BGP paths diverging for subset of prefixes.

anya: hypothesis — GSLB returned a mix of healthy and degraded POP IPs due to stale health signals + DNS multipath from certain resolvers. That explains why only some clients hit the bad path. Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) reduce GSLB weight to 0 for eu-pop-b 2) lower DNS TTL to 30s temporarily 3) pin in-flight customers to eu-pop-a where possible.

carlos: executing weight fallback now — setting eu-pop-b weight->0 and lowering TTL ->30s. Pushing a temporary route pin for active sessions via our edge-controller.

carlos: done. GSLB weight changed at 09:28 UTC, TTL lowered. Rolling affinity cookie enabled for new sessions.

alex: watching metrics — p99 started falling at 09:31, current p99 ~520ms, p95 ~430ms. Customer confirms improvement for previously affected request ids. :thumbsup:

maria: collected PCAPs pre/post; attaching to ticket and creating a short incident note. Recommend eng-infra to run peering and BGP path digests for eu-pop-b prefix (possible upstream flapping).

jin: opened infra ticket INFRA-1149 for deep BGP/peering analysis and to verify health-checking for GSLB probe thresholds.

anya: operational follow-ups: 1) revert TTL to normal after 2hr stable 2) adjust health-check sensitivity if needed 3) add synthetic checks hitting all POPs for TLS handshake duration alerting.

support-bot: updated CustX ticket C-7921 with mitigation steps and ETA for a postmortem. Marking as mitigated but monitoring; will close when stable for 30m.

alex: note for postmortem — include DNS multipath repro steps and the exact probe outputs. I'll capture the eval harness runbook.

carlos: leaving a watch on the routing change for next 60m. Ping me if anything reappears.

ops-bot: monitor configured: alert if eu-west p99 > 900ms for 5m.
